grh_451356a177bea9115bd9.title: Derelicts
paragraphs: Police bring alcoholic drifter Jim Martin into the hospital, where Dr. Christian discovers that the watch Jim guards so fiercely is one of the few things left from the life he lost. Jim was once the successful author of the popular Danny Dean children's books, but after an automobile accident killed his wife and son while he was driving, guilt destroyed his family life and his career and he drifted into drink. In the next room, an orphan boy named Les is recovering from pneumonia and happens to adore the Danny Dean stories. Christian brings the two together without initially revealing Jim's identity. Les's admiration draws Jim back into storytelling, and Jim begins writing again. When officials prepare to return Les to an institution, Jim finally recognizes that both of them have been living as derelicts without families. He races to the station, stops the boy from being sent away and announces that he will adopt Les, giving both of them a home and a new start.
GRH catalogs [[show|dr-christian|Dr. Christian]]'s "Derelicts" for April 3, 1940, as episode 74.
